results.title: CLARITY Act Setback 'Not Major' As Crypto Stocks Tumble 10%: What's Next For The Industry?
results.description: Despite heavy losses in crypto-linked stocks, expert believes the Senate vote for the CLARITY Act was not a major setback.

results.title: India to generate 2.5L seasonal, gig jobs this festive season
results.description: India is expected to create between 2-2.5 lakh seasonal and gig jobs during the July-December festive season of 2026, a report by NLB Services has said.
